priority: Fill the arbitrary-physical-xyz API capability gap after the current nodal signed-S pair; do not add a concurrent GPU task or claim that this resolves signed-S accuracy.
question: Can one complete-CAD spatial index retrieve all conservative curved-TET10 candidates and return bounded native physical-coordinate U/one-sided-gradient queries at useful measured cold cost?

inherited_context.available_evidence: All5 full4Q U/X/physical-gradient candidate arrays and <=32-cell physical inversion passed; the current GeometryLocator is bounded NumPy code, not a whole-CAD fast locator.
inherited_context.inherited_cost_policy: Accepted physical-field construction and prior capability costs remain separate. Prior total14.25s includes the former stage's work and is not substituted for a new target-free arbitrary-query service cost.

single_route.index: Fixed R64 cubical CSR voxel grid, built once per full CAD on CPU and transferred to GPU; no resolution search, nearest-cell fallback, selected-cell submesh or candidate top-k.
single_route.inverse: New isolated, streamed Torch CUDA FP64 implementation of the pinned native Newton equations and fixed acceptance policy; original bounded GeometryLocator/helper source remains unchanged. The GPU implementation and its cost are not yet verified.
single_route.cell_identity: Every original cells10 row and original GRID/CTETRA identity is retained. CSR cell IDs are canonical original row IDs, sorted ascending within each voxel.
single_route.coordinate_frame: Physical mm; J[c,r]=dX_c/dr_r and grad_X_N=solve(J^T,dN_dr). L is the immutable accepted CAD characteristic length, used only for dimensionless residual/regularity tests.
single_route.inputs_to_locator: physical_xyz[Q,3] only; no oracle original cell row, quadrature index, reference barycentric coordinate or predicted-field value enters candidate search or Newton seeds.

conservative_index_contract.controls: Four corner controls plus six degree2 edge controls Cij=2*Xmid-(Xi+Xj)/2. AABB is the componentwise bound of all10 Bernstein controls, not nodal or corner AABB.
conservative_index_contract.rounding: FP64 outward interval arithmetic for the sums/scales/subtraction and subsequent box-to-voxel arithmetic; nextafter bounds at each operation. Do not rely on one final nextafter to repair an under-rounded intermediate control.
conservative_index_contract.global_box: The outward union of all full-CAD Bezier boxes; embed it in one outward-expanded cube and divide each axis into exactly64 bins. A point outside this conservative global box is certified outside this input geometry.
conservative_index_contract.membership: Insert each cell into every voxel intersecting its closed conservative AABB, using inclusive outward-rounded endpoint bin bounds. Exact upper cube boundaries map to the last bin for indexing only; physical query coordinates are never clamped.
conservative_index_contract.query: Look up one voxel CSR row, then test every returned cell's conservative AABB in FP64. All candidates passing that box test are visited; the index is a broad phase, not a containment test.
conservative_index_contract.first_actual_index_witness: All2737880 held-out full4Q coordinates must have their original cell present in the candidate row before inverse validation. Original owner is used only by this separate verifier, never by index construction or runtime search.
conservative_index_contract.full_geometry_check: One streamed finite/all11-native-node-plus-center Jacobian regularity/sign check per original cell while preparing this locator. It is geometry admission only, not another elasticity K guard or physical solve. Sampled regularity is not a global no-fold theorem.

seeds: affine-corner inverse when the corner matrix meets the pinned regularity policy
fixed_inverse_policy.root_policy: Retain both seed roots before numerical equivalence. Distinct same-cell accepted roots are ambiguous; accepted interior roots in unrelated cells are overlapping/ambiguous. Never deduplicate by cell ID before comparing barycentric roots.
fixed_inverse_policy.boundary_tie: Only allow a common topological face/edge/vertex with matching active global corner IDs and edge-associated midside IDs, compatible physical position and U traces. Then select the lowest original cell row deterministically and return its one-sided physical gradient; expose all accepted side IDs. A C0 displacement field need not be C1.
fixed_inverse_policy.optional_S_tie: If a later frozen nodal signed-S prediction is supplied, expose the same signed10-P2 interpolation and its trace diagnostic; it does not certify the original source stress definition. No S input or S gate is required for this independent U test.
fixed_inverse_policy.unresolved_competitors: Count every failed/outside/nonconverged candidate seed. A found owner under two fixed seeds does not prove that another unobserved root is absent; retain this disclosure rather than calling the result globally certified unique.
fixed_inverse_policy.no_substitution: No nearest/P1/extrapolation, barycentric clipping, coordinate clamp, owner hint, candidate dropping or tolerance change after outcomes.

native_output.basis: All signed10 quadratic Lagrange weights at the accepted inverse barycentric root.
native_output.U: sum_i N_i U_i, physical mm, in original displacement coordinate components.
native_output.G: G[a,b]=sum_i U[i,a]*grad_X_N[i,b], dimensionless, one selected element side.
native_output.engineering6_optional: [Gxx,Gyy,Gzz,Gxy+Gyx,Gxz+Gzx,Gyz+Gzy]; no constitutive or source-strain label claim.
native_output.S_optional: sum_i N_i predicted_signedS_i in MPa only after that exact fixed nodal prediction/validity endpoint is separately ready and pinned; negative P2 weights may overshoot nodal values and are not clipped.
native_output.returned_metadata: status, selected original row, accepted side IDs, barycentric root, position residual/L, candidate/seed/iteration counts, regularity/overlap diagnostics and unresolved-candidate counts.

single_target_free_validation.main_coordinates: Stream only persisted candidate query_X_mm.npy from all5 original-cell/fourQ outputs. The geometry-generated2737880 positions are the locator input; canonical fourQ barycentrics and owner IDs are withheld until verification.
single_target_free_validation.owner_checks: Full fixed denominator2737880 and684470 cells: zero missing original-owner candidate memberships; every query accepted under the bounded policy with the original owner; one observed equivalent interior root/cell; no discovered overlaps or ambiguous roots. Record observed owner uniqueness, not certified global uniqueness.
single_target_free_validation.native_replay: Compare recovered position residual/L<=1e-10, recovered known-owner barycentric difference<=1e-7, signed10 U replay against persisted candidate U using the parent's fixed numerical trace scale. Recompute the known-owner physical basis gradients only in the verifier and require relative Frobenius replay error<=1e-7 with their finite nonzero norm. Report direct native G replay separately, zero reference=>null plus absolute error; no GT-dependent calibration.
single_target_free_validation.face_queries: First8 lexicographic conforming interior face pairs per CAD, with canonical center and [0.2,0.3,0.5] face positions. Only their physical xyz enters the full index. Require common-entity/trace-compatible tie and deterministic row selection; retain both one-sided normal derivatives, with no C1 gate.
single_target_free_validation.outside_queries: Eight global outward-box corners moved outward by0.01L must return certified outside. Additionally sixteen fixed first-lexicographic empty-voxel centers per CAD, if such voxels exist, test whole-index no-candidate handling inside the conservative global box; a no-candidate observation is disclosed without inventing an inverse or nearest value. Missing empty voxels are recorded, not replaced adaptively.
single_target_free_validation.not_a_general_point_distribution: The exhaustive4Q interior test plus fixed boundary/outside cases establishes this bounded replay coverage. It does not cover all arbitrary external service points or prove all-domain injectivity.

fixed_proposed_resources_and_accounting.memory_contract: Compute complete membership counts before allocation; int64 rowptr and pair offsets, int32 original cell IDs within the actual input's safe range. Stream all candidate pairs in65536-pair tiles, do not form Q-by-T distances or full all-query-by-candidate X/J/gradient arrays. Carry sufficient accepted-root information to decide every tie; if exact storage/budget cannot fit, stop explicitly instead of truncating roots/candidates. Persist one CAD's outputs before releasing device arrays.
fixed_proposed_resources_and_accounting.index_cap_meaning: A complete index exceeding the fixed membership or CPU/GPU memory cap is a terminal resource negative. The cap never removes entries, cells or queries.
costs: accepted input/physical-U/candidate-coordinate read and identity IO
cold Bezier/control/geometry admission and CPU CSR build
imports/CUDA startup and total cold wall
fixed_proposed_resources_and_accounting.clock: One cumulative stage ledger across resume; include metadata, cache reads, transfer, index build, queries, validation and persistence. Sync CUDA at measured phase boundaries. Complete persisted CADs are not replayed, negative budget/resource outcomes remain terminal. Finite endpoint finalization overshoot is recorded, not hidden.
fixed_proposed_resources_and_accounting.service_limits: Report new index cold cost and actual aggregate/per-million-coordinate query cost separately, plus cache-hit index query cost if naturally available from this one run; no repeat warm benchmark. Inherited physical field cost is a disclosed prerequisite, not a fresh jointly measured raw-deck-to-query request.
fixed_proposed_resources_and_accounting.unknown_cost: No measured membership count, candidate multiplicity, full-CAD inverse throughput, memory peak or GPU backend parity yet. The budgets are bounded proposal limits, not performance predictions.

allowed: accepted5 input vertices_mm/cells10 and original identity metadata
persisted candidate_X/U/G arrays and prediction manifests only
optional separately frozen predicted nodalS only if ready

finite_stop_decision: One route only. If this fixed complete index/inverse cannot provide the full replay within the caps, report the precise missing coverage, ambiguity or resource failure and stop; do not tune R/seeds/tolerances or promote the bounded known-cell API into a global guarantee. No implementation, preparation or actual execution is authorized by this design file.
